power_domains_summary.PCD_AVDD: Analog supply for PCD oscillator / TX modulator / RX (typ 3.3 V).
power_domains_summary.PCD_DVDD: Digital supply for PCD logic (typ 3.3 V or 1.8 V).
power_domains_summary.PCD_PVDD: Pad / antenna driver supply (3.3 V to 5 V).
power_domains_summary.PCD_HOST_BUS_VDD: Host bus I/O supply (3.3 V or 1.8 V).
power_domains_summary.PICC_VCC_INTERNAL: PICC field-rectified VCC (typ 1.8 V); generated on-chip — no external power pin.

power_up_sequence: 1. Host MCU applies AVDD / DVDD / PVDD to PCD chip.
3. PCD chip boots in disabled / field-off state.
5. Host MCU commands PCD to turn on antenna driver.
6. PCD waits ≥ 5 ms for any PICC POR before first REQA.
7. PICC: rectifier output rises; internal POR releases at VCC ≥ 1.6 V.
power_down_sequence: 1. Host MCU commands PCD to turn off antenna driver.
2. PICC: rectifier output falls; all PICC state lost.
3. Host MCU may assert NRSTPD to fully power-down PCD chip.

low_power_modes_summary.PCD_field_off: PCD antenna driver disabled; max power saving.
low_power_modes_summary.PICC_HALT: PICC ignores REQA; only WUPA wakes it.

power_consumption_typical.PICC_field_powered_µA: 5..20 (idle / HALT) ; up to 1 mA during EEPROM write

field_strength_for_power_budget.operating_envelope_per_class: Class 1 antenna: 0..100 mm; Class 2/3/4 progressively reduced.

fields.notes: Power intent is asymmetric: PCD requires DC power and active control; PICC requires only an RF field. There is no PICC-side power switch or sleep register exposed on the air interface — the PCD modulates PICC power by controlling the field.

extraction_hints: Look for power-domain partitioning, supply nets.
